changeLog:
BD MIL GADGET 1.0.2 - SEA, SKY & SHARE UPDATE

⚓ NEW: NAVY & AIR TAB
• NAVY: passage leg on the map, course to steer through a current, CPA collision check, horizon & light range, sextant distance off, tide (rule of twelfths), Beaufort, endurance with radius-of-action ring
• AIR: nav leg with wind triangle, runway/LZ crosswind, pressure & density altitude, true airspeed, fuel & time, descent planning, equal-time point & point of no return

🧭 FOLLOW
• Shows TO ROUTE START while heading to the first point
• Clear in night vision: status by brightness, off-route brightest
• TRACKER + FOLLOW now share the GPS cleanly; notification shows what is really running

🎯 ARTY & MAPS
• Type 6/8/10-figure GR (with map sheet) or lat/lon on every tool map
• TRUE / MAG / GRID north for artillery

🔁 ROUTES: SHARE, BACKUP & RESTORE
• Share one, several or all routes (with waypoints) - the other phone opens the file straight in the app and imports it, duplicates skipped, ready to FOLLOW
• Full backup to Drive / WhatsApp / Bluetooth and one-tap restore
• GPX import and export for other map apps

🔔 Update alerts now appear on the next launch after a release
⚡ Faster, smoother, more robust

📖 Field manual updated for every tab
